title: Compaction summary restates a secret that entered the transcript
reason_not_testable: No hook sees the compaction summary (PreCompact can only block, PostCompact has no decision control, per b013 mitigation). The covering control is the prompt-entry block in LEAK-0277, which keeps the value out of the transcript. That control is itself a UserPromptSubmit hook, so this is a partial non-hook gap; the compaction block option is UNVERIFIED.
